g.text: Compare x-coordinate with root node, if less than root x-coordinate see left else see right. Here -9 < 1 (go left). Update LDP = (1,2)
Compare y-coordinate with node, if less than node y-coordinate see down else see up. Here -3 < 2 (go down) (go left in binary tree). Update LDP = (-8,2)
Compare x-coordinate with node, if less than x-coordinate see left else see right. Here -9 > -11 (go right). Update LDP = (-11,-6)
Here -3 < 1, go down (go left in binary tree), but there is no points below (-4,1). Hence it is a leaf node.
Now we compare the least distance we have till not i.e., point (-11,-6) to leaf node point (-4,1). we see that leaf node distance is more. Hence we reject
it i.e., we don't update the least distance point, LDP = (-11,-6)
